name: less
summary: Opposite of more; interactive file pager.
description: less is a program similar to more, but which allows backward movement in the file as well as forward movement.

options.description: Cause line numbers to be displayed in each line.
Causes lines longer than the screen width to be chopped rather than wrapped.

examples.title: View large log file interactively
examples.explanation: Allows scrolling up and down through massive log files without loading all into memory.

useCases: Browsing large log files or source code files page by page
